source.title: Empirical Evaluation of Multi-Agent Research Systems

summary: This empirical study evaluates the consistency and hallucination rates of autonomous research agents operating on multi-source evidence corpora. The authors demonstrate that two-store validation reduces ungrounded claims significantly across benchmark datasets.

claims.text: Two-store validation with PostgreSQL as the system of record reduces claim hallucination by 42% compared to vector-only memory.
Deterministic UUIDv5 vector indexing ensures complete idempotency across repeated pipeline analysis stages.
